commands.limit: Final backend source; subsequent changes were frontend-only and documentation.

commands.scope: Simulated product facade regression; no native bridge acceptance.

real: journal file I/O, file Sync, rename and directory Sync
mock: Wails bridge replaced by authenticated HTTP test transport
write/read/clear and reply-loss faults injected at browser transport boundary

limits: Service/SQLite reopen and page reload tested; no native Wails process kill or power-loss acceptance
No injected fsync/rename hardware failure or full-disk exercise; filesystem errors tested through invalid file/directory paths
No cross-platform file-system or Windows/macOS acceptance
No recovery for unapplied time-map forms, numeric/velocity/playback drafts or pointer previews
Journal ownership relies on existing single-host directory lock; independently constructed concurrent Services sharing one directory are unsupported
Journal records metadata only; it cannot replay an operation or replace music history
No model, physical audio/device or dense-arrangement performance acceptance in this increment
developmentFindings: Browser mute/solo regression now waits for the whole GUI operation to finish, including journal cleanup, before clicking the next disabled control
Go reopen assertion checks the authoritative state title; existing denormalized storage title behavior was outside this scope
Recovery status identifies the original project when a different project is selected
